meaning:
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ
to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), Luk.22:31 (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,
